item.title: Bursa Malaysia opened lower as Wall Street declined
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Bursa Malaysia opened lower on Friday, driven by moderate profit-taking activity at selected counters, in line with Wall Street’s overnight decline on continued global cautious sentiment. At 9.10am, the FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI (FBM KLCI) declined 3.73 points to 1,727.29 after opening 1.79 points lower at 1,729.23 from 1,731.02 at the close on Thursday. item.title: India, Malaysia to discuss trade deal review during Modi’s visit
item.description: NEW DELHI: India and Malaysia will discuss the review of their bilateral free trade agreement, among other issues, during Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s visit to Malaysia this weekend. The move is part of efforts to increase bilateral trade “in a balanced and sustainable manner”, according to Periasamy Kumaran, secretary at India’s Ministry of External Affairs. item.title: Mitsubishi Xforce officially open for bookings, prices start at RM110,000
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Mitsubishi Motors Malaysia (MMM) has officially opened bookings for its latest SUV model, the Mitsubishi Xforce, marking the vehicle’s official entry into the increasingly competitive compact SUV segment in the local market.
